propositions: A missing JIRA_PAT resolves to an empty string and is passed as the bearer token, causing anonymous Jira access instead of failing with a named error.
The documented security guarantee that a missing JIRA_PAT fails with an error naming the variable is not enforced, so the backend fails open to anonymous.
Anonymous access surfaces as 'project does not exist' errors that misattribute the failure away from the credential, or silently pass on permissive instances.
The PAT must be validated at client construction in build_client_from_settings, rejecting empty or whitespace-only values before any network call.
Validation must not live in settings resolution because a raise there breaks Protocol conformance checks on Python 3.11, which evaluate query_project via hasattr.
Settings resolution must stay total (non-raising) on a missing credential, and a PAT present only in a config file must not satisfy the env-only contract.
